thread:
elaine: Quick sync on rerank API semantics — want to lock defaults before spec freeze.
vikram: main debate = do we normalize scores server-side? customers expect both raw and normalized.
sam: propose default normalized = softmax over returned top_k; also include raw_score for transparency.
lisa: performance question: can we softmax after truncation? I think we should: score raw for all candidates, pick top_k, then normalize only over returned slice.
elaine: agreed. that keeps cost bounded. sequence: ingest -> optional early filters -> score -> select top_k -> normalize.
pm-jon: product requirements: deterministic output for same input + model_version in meta. also need stable tie-breaking.
vikram: add stable tie breaker policy: sort by score desc, then candidate_id asc. expose tie_breaker enum.
sam: truncation modes to include: client_drop, server_best, error_on_overflow. default = server_best with warning header.
lisa: add header X-Rerank-Warning with reason when truncation happened and meta.truncated=true.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary plan: rerank-v3 -> 3% -> 10% -> monitor p95, error rate, and rerank NDCG signals.
elaine: caps: max_return = 500 by default; hard reject if payload > 4MB or candidates > 5000 with error_code=payload_too_big and suggested_batch_size.
vikram: sanitize top_k: if top_k <= 0 => respond with 400? maybe coerce to 1 and include warning.
sam: prefer coercion + warning; clients rarely expect HTTP error for small mistakes.
lisa: normalization options: none | softmax | minmax | percentile. default softmax. none => skip score_norm to save compute.
elaine: include score fields: score_raw (float32), score_norm (float) when requested or default. and ranking_rank (1..k).
pm-jon: launch gates: 1) p95 latency delta <= +12ms vs v2 on 100 candidates; 2) internal NDCG top-5 within 1% absolute; 3) SDK + docs updated; 4) canary metrics green for 48h.
vikram: sample request shape we should standardize:
```
{
  "query": "reset password",
  "candidates": [{"id":"c_42","text":"...","meta":{}}, ...],
  "top_k": 10,
  "truncate_mode": "server_best",
  "normalize": "softmax",
  "tie_breaker": "stable",
  "score_scaling": 1.0
}
```
sam: response example:
```
{
  "results": [{"id":"c_42","rank":1,"score_raw":12.34,"score_norm":0.41}, ...],
  "meta": {"truncated":true,"original_count":1200,"model_version":"v3.1","model_hash":"abc123"}
}
```
lisa: add meta.truncation_reason enum: payload_limit | timeout | client_requested. helpful for debugging.
elaine: error codes: payload_too_big (413), invalid_candidates (400), server_overload (429) with retry-after.
vikram: implement numeric stability: compute softmax with max-subtraction (log-sum-exp) over returned items.
sam: for very large candidate sets we still need an efficient top-k algorithm. plan: streaming scorer + heap to keep top_k, avoid scoring all fully where possible.
infra-bot: [infra-bot] note: route requests with candidates>64 to large-batch nodes to avoid latency spikes.
pm-jon: SDK defaults: JS + Python should return both scores by default but make score_norm optional in lightweight mode.
lisa: add optional request field `return_grouping` that groups items within epsilon into same group_id for bucketed ranking.
vikram: cap top_k to 500 server-side unless account config overrides.
elaine: commit items: 1) finalize proto + HTTP contract (vikram) 2) implement server_best truncation + headers (sam) 3) SDK + examples (lisa) 4) canary + gating (pm-jon). owners noted.
pm-jon: timeline: API freeze Thu EOD, canary next Tue, GA in 2 weeks if evals pass.
sam: security note: redact candidate text from logs by default; include allow_logging flag if customer opts in.
elaine: good call. ping security to review telemetry implications.
ops-bot: [reminder-bot] Spec review Thurs 9:30am
vikram: will open PR for HTTP contract + proto tomorrow, will tag reviewers.
elaine: thanks all — feel comfortable with defaults: normalize=softmax, truncate=server_best, return raw+norm. we'll capture decisions in spec.
